The name Shai carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shai usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
